title: Floating bottom bar with center + action in a smooth bump (light and dark)

observed.layout: Two floating bars, light above and dark below, each with five slots: home, chat, center plus, bell, profile. The center plus sits in a smooth wave-shaped bump in the bar's top edge. Light: filled purple gradient circle with glow and a dotted halo ring. Dark: ring-outline circle with glow. Active = filled home icon plus a small purple dot beneath.
observed.hierarchy: Center action first, active dot second.
observed.iconography: Outline icons; filled variant for active.
observed.materials: Light: off-white bar with soft shadow. Dark: near-black bar with soft shadow.

implementation_notes: Bump: SVG path with smooth curves rather than a circular cutout.
Halo: radial dotted ring or conic mask; glow via blurred accent shadow.
Dark variant swaps the filled circle for an outlined ring to keep the bar quiet.

concept_work.essence: A calm bar whose only saturated element is the action the user is most likely to take.
what_makes_it_work: Organic bump reads as part of the bar, not a pasted button.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Icon-only navigation depends on icon recognition; no labels.
Generic '+' does not say what it creates.
Dark ring may read as disabled.

pattern.name: Floating pill bar with center action in a smooth bump
use_when: Apps with a frequent create action
avoid_when: Users need text labels to understand icons
must_preserve: Accent used only for primary action and active indicator
Bump continuous with the bar edge
adaptation_examples: Notes app: center creates a note, brand-color accent.
Food delivery: add persistent labels and make the center 'Order'.

lessons: Confine the accent color to the action and the active state.
Derive the dark theme from the same geometry instead of redesigning it.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Neutral bars with one purple accent used for the center action and active dot only.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: Generic social-app context; no domain content to anchor purpose.
Clean spacing, soft shadows, deliberate accent use.
Center-action bar is an established pattern executed with a continuous curve and active indicator.
Active state shown; no labels, pressed or badge states.
Both themes share geometry, spacing and icon style.
Center-action nav is common; the organic bump and halo add some distinction.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min n/a:1; secondary text min n/a:1; icon min 7.35:1; non-color state cue: True. Capped at 3: meaning depends on icon recognition or hover-only labels.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
